output.content:
**Saved comparison (exact elapsed-time matching, 9 matched samples, glucose in g/L, difference = CHO-007-R02 minus CHO-007-R01):**

- **Mean signed difference: −0.207 g/L** — CHO-007-R02 ran slightly lower on glucose than CHO-007-R01 across the run.
- **Largest absolute difference: 0.555 g/L at 18.0 h** (CHO-007-R01: 7.83 g/L, CHO-007-R02: 7.275 g/L); the only positive difference was +0.066 g/L at 0.0 h, and every later sample favored R01.
- **Batches compared: CHO-007-R01 and CHO-007-R02**, both from the Northfield Biologics November delivery.

Details from the saved result:

| Elapsed h | CHO-007-R01 (g/L) | CHO-007-R02 (g/L) | Difference (g/L) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.0 | 7.618 | 7.684 | +0.066 |
| 18.0 | 7.830 | 7.275 | **−0.555** |
| 74.0 | 5.973 | 5.622 | −0.351 |
| 90.0 | 4.330 | 4.200 | −0.130 |
| 98.0 | 3.338 | 3.249 | −0.089 |
| 114.0 | 2.464 | 2.076 | −0.388 |
| 122.5 | 1.662 | 1.414 | −0.248 |
| 138.0 | 0.616 | 0.509 | −0.107 |
| 146.0 | 0.220 | 0.161 | −0.059 |

Two caveats from the check: CHO-007-R01's sample at 44.0 h had no counterpart because CHO-007-R02 has conflicting duplicate glucose entries at 44.0 h that need source review, so 9 of 10 R01 samples were matched. Product, process version, equipment, scale and stage are not recorded for either batch, so the comparison is descriptive only — no cause is implied.

**Provisional status:** the values came from deliveries still in review — the Northfield Biologics November runs (used here), the Northfield October runs, and the Harborview CDMO fed-batch runs. All values are read from the delivery files and not yet reviewed; nothing was accepted on a reviewer's behalf, so treat these numbers as unreviewed until the delivery is verified.
